title: A same-name QuickBooks customer linked elsewhere puts the invoice on Unexported
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company that you can sign in to.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, already linked to a QuickBooks customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, not linked to QuickBooks, whose name is exactly the name of customer D's QuickBooks customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Open the Unexported report.
  5. In QuickBooks, open the invoice with work order 1's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created in ShopView.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's invoice, billed to customer B, is listed with the reason "QuickBooks customer [that QuickBooks customer's name] is already linked to another ShopView customer."

Step 5:

  • No QuickBooks invoice exists with that number: the invoice was not sent, and customer D's QuickBooks customer has no new invoice.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
